name_reason: The '_via_d1b' suffix is a Ghidra address residual: d1b = 0xD1B, the low bytes of address 0x22D1B = the worker fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell this function delegates to. The naming rule forbids encoding a callee's address in the name. Proposed fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell_wrapper references the worker by its semantic name (fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell) and marks this as its MP-deduct + delegate wrapper. Mirrors the family naming and parallels the sister wrapper fd2_apply_status_effect_with_anim @ 0x22AA8 (same reset/deduct/delegate shape but delegating to the cure worker). Evidence: disasm 0x22d12 CALL 0x22d1b (target = fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell); the wrapper forwards all 5 of its params to that worker after deducting MP with params 1,2.
purpose: Thin wrapper for status-effect (inflict) spells: reset the AoE/fx-queue counter, deduct the caster's MP for the spell, then delegate the whole cast to the status-inflict worker fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell @ 0x22D1B.
